raw_messages.text: US HOUSE GETS ENOUGH VOTES TO PASS MOTION TO DISCHARGE ON PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF THE BILL (H.R. 2913) TO AUTHORIZE SUPPORT FOR UKRAINE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES, VOTING CONTINUES
HOUSE FOR THE FIRST TIME PASSES RESOLUTION TO HALT MILITARY ACTION AGAINST IRAN IN REBUKE OF TRUMP'S WAR

actionable_intel.headline: US House passes resolution to halt military action against Iran — first such rebuke of Trump's war powers
actionable_intel.event: The US House of Representatives voted to pass a resolution (for the first time) that halts military action against Iran. This is a direct legislative rebuke of the Trump administration's authorization to use force. Passage is confirmed as of 21:25 UTC, June 3, 2026.
actionable_intel.narrative_consensus: The mainstream narrative will frame this as a partisan check on executive war powers — a procedural victory for the anti-war bloc. The establishment line will downplay market impact, calling it 'symbolic' and noting it still needs Senate action or may face veto.
actionable_intel.contradiction: This is anything but symbolic. The House passing a war-halting resolution against Iran for the FIRST TIME creates massive legal and political uncertainty around any future kinetic action. War risk premium in oil prices collapses immediately. The Strait of Hormuz blockade scenario — the primary bullish thesis for crude since Q4 2025 — just lost its political backbone. Markets will front-run this: oil drops before the ink dries.

primary.asset: Crude Oil (WTI / Brent futures, USO, XLE)
primary.rationale: Iran war risk premium was the #1 bullish driver for crude in H1 2026. This resolution removes that premium instantly. Expect algorithmics to front-run hard.
primary.volume_impact: Extreme — breakout gap likely at next open. Over $50B notional at risk in oil futures in first hour.

secondary.rationale: Geopolitical risk premium unwind. Iran de-escalation removes one of the three pillars of the gold bid (alongside Fed cuts and dollar weakness). Expect $30-50/oz drop.
secondary.volume_impact: High — gold structurally overbought on war premium. Stop-loss cascade likely below $3100.

tertiary.asset: US Defense Stocks (LMT, NOC, RTX, GD)
tertiary.rationale: Short-term selling on reduced Middle Eastern conflict premium. These names rallied hard on Iran escalation expectations. Cash flows unwind.
tertiary.target_move: -2% to -4% in defense ETF (ITA) within 2 hours
tertiary.volume_impact: High institutional rotation out of war-bet defense names.

contrarian.rationale: De-escalation is risk-on. Bitcoin trades as a liquidity proxy — reduced geopolitical angst = capital flows back into risk assets. The 'digital gold' narrative inverse to actual gold here.
contrarian.volume_impact: Moderate — correlated with SPX futures rally on war-unwind.

actionable_intel.headline: US House clears procedural hurdle for Ukraine support bill H.R. 2913 — voting underway
actionable_intel.event: The US House secured enough votes to pass a motion to discharge on H.R. 2913, a bill to authorize support for Ukraine. The motion forces the bill to the floor for consideration. Voting was still ongoing at 21:24 UTC on June 3, 2026.
actionable_intel.narrative_consensus: The establishment line: 'Bipartisan Ukraine support continues, the House is doing its job. This is routine procedure.' Media will focus on the procedural mechanics, not the signal it sends to Moscow.
actionable_intel.contradiction: This motion to discharge is NOT routine — it was forced because leadership was dragging its feet. The fact that supporters had to use a discharge petition means there was significant opposition to even CONSIDERING Ukraine aid. The 'bipartisan consensus' narrative is a fiction. What's actually happening: the pro-Ukraine coalition is on the back foot, fighting for procedural scraps to keep aid alive. The signal to Putin: US Ukraine support is fracturing, every extension is a battle now.

primary.asset: VanEck Ukraine ETF (UKR — if tradable) / Ukrainian sovereign bonds (Ukraine 2035s)
primary.direction: LONG / BUY cautiously on passage, front-run on motion-to-discharge success
primary.rationale: Motion to discharge passing = bill gets a floor vote. This is the first positive Ukraine legislative signal in weeks. Ukrainian bonds have been bleeding on aid fatigue. Any sign of renewed commitment stops the bleed.
primary.target_move: +1% to +3% in Ukrainian sovereign bonds within 2 hours
primary.volume_impact: Low liquidity — thin market means outsized moves on small flows.

secondary.asset: European Defense (EUAD, Rheinmetall RHM.DE, Thales HO.PA)
secondary.rationale: US recommitment to Ukraine = longer war = sustained European defense spending. Rheinmetall specifically benefits from Ukrainian ammunition contracts.
secondary.volume_impact: Moderate — European defense has been consolidating. This breaks the short-term downtrend.

contrarian.rationale: If Ukraine aid passes, the war continues at current intensity. No peace deal in sight = Russian economy bleeds longer. Ruble weakens on renewed sanctions risk.
contrarian.volume_impact: Low — RSX is mostly garbage. Symbolic more than actionable for liquidity.
